subject.title: 飞书消息回复引用(replyTo)有时不显示 - OpenClaw 2026.3.23-2

question: Should maintainers repair the overlapping Feishu topic-anchor PR, open a smaller credited replacement for explicit `replyTo` anchoring, or keep this issue separate until the `replies=0` symptom is narrowed?
rationale: Current source still supports the report, but an open proof-positive PR overlaps the fix and has compatibility blockers, so creating another independent repair risks conflicting Feishu routing changes.

options.title: Repair or replace the overlapping PR
options.body: Rebase or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78964 with a narrower Feishu fix that preserves current normal-group and P2P invariants while adding explicit send `replyTo` anchoring.

options.title: Keep only the no-reply issue canonical
options.body: If maintainers decide this report is mainly about `replies=0`, route follow-up through https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/91669 and leave explicit quote anchoring to a separate PR.

options.title: Wait for a fresh live repro
options.body: Hold implementation until a Feishu tenant repro separates quote-rendering failures from final-delivery suppression.

recommendation.title: Repair or replace the overlapping PR
recommendation.body: Rebase or replace https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/78964 with a narrower Feishu fix that preserves current normal-group and P2P invariants while adding explicit send `replyTo` anchoring.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent merged Feishu channel-action and native-card send work makes this the strongest available routing owner for the maintainer choice.
